info.title: Osintly API
info.description: OpenAPI specification for the Osintly API service.

tags.name: Search
tags.description: Create, monitor and retrieve search results

get.description: Return a lightweight service health response to confirm that the API is reachable and responding.
Validate the current bearer token and confirm that the API key can access protected endpoints.
Return current API usage, allowance state, and request limits for the authenticated API key.

post.description: Queue a new OSINT search with optional module selection, leak sources, account features, delivery settings, cache mode, and BYOK provider configuration.

email_search.summary: Email search with selected modules, webhook and BYOK

get.description: Return the current lifecycle state of a search, including summary counters, webhook delivery status, and follow-up links.
Return normalized search results for standard modules and BYOK providers, along with breached and registered account outputs when available.

200.description: Modules, breached accounts and registered accounts results

get.description: Return BYOK provider execution status, result counters, errors, and stored provider payloads for a search.

parameters.name: provider
parameters.description: Filter the response to a single BYOK provider. When omitted, all available BYOK providers for the search are returned.

200.description: BYOK provider status, metadata, and stored payloads

get.description: List persisted leak sources for a search with their status, counts, pagination hints, and fetch URLs.
Return normalized results for a single persisted leak source, including pagination data and the result template.
Open a Server-Sent Events stream for real-time search progress, module results, BYOK events, leak status updates, and final completion.

Page.description: Page number for paginated leak sources
